responses.what is shivbhumi: Shivbhumi Shikshan Mandal is a renowned educational institution in Pune, established in 1957. It comprises four schools and a junior college, nurturing minds with academic excellence and strong Indian values.
responses.what is shivbhumi shikshan mandal: Shivbhumi Shikshan Mandal is a prestigious educational organization founded in 1957 by Shikshan Maharshi Late Shri Shivajirao Narayanrao Konde-Deshmukh. It operates four schools and a junior college in Pune, Maharashtra.
responses.when was shivbhumi established: Shivbhumi Shikshan Mandal was established on March 13, 1957, and has been delivering quality education for over 65 years.
responses.who founded shivbhumi: Shivbhumi Shikshan Mandal was founded by Shikshan Maharshi Late Shri Shivajirao Narayanrao Konde-Deshmukh, who was honored with the prestigious Shikshan Maharshi Award for his contributions to education.
responses.where is shivbhumi located: Shivbhumi Shikshan Mandal has multiple campuses across Pune, including locations in Nigdi, Khed Shivapur, Kondhanpur, and Shivare.
responses.what programs does shivbhumi offer: Shivbhumi offers comprehensive education from nursery to junior college level, including State Board schools, CBSE English Medium School, and Junior College with Science, Commerce, and Arts streams.
responses.what courses are available at shivbhumi: Shivbhumi Junior College offers HSC courses in Science (PCM/PCB), Commerce, and Arts streams. Schools offer education from nursery to 10th standard under State Board and CBSE curricula.
responses.does shivbhumi have junior college: Yes, Shivbhumi Junior College is located in Yamunanagar, Nigdi, Pune, offering Science and Arts streams with excellent faculty and modern laboratories for HSC board students.
responses.what is the address of shivbhumi: The main address is Sector 21, Yamunanagar, Nigdi, Pune – 411044, Maharashtra, India.
responses.what is shivbhumi contact number: You can contact Shivbhumi at phone numbers: 020-27660376 or 9881483762.
responses.how many students are in shivbhumi: Shivbhumi Shikshan Mandal serves over 3000 students across its four campuses.
responses.how many teachers work at shivbhumi: Shivbhumi has over 100 dedicated faculty members.
responses.what makes shivbhumi special: Shivbhumi stands out with academic excellence, holistic development, modern laboratories, Indian values & culture, safe transport, biometric attendance, and 65+ years of educational legacy.
responses.why choose shivbhumi: Choose Shivbhumi for consistently top board results, modern infrastructure, holistic development through sports and arts, strong Indian values, safe transportation, and personalized attention from experienced faculty.
responses.what facilities does shivbhumi have: Shivbhumi offers world-class infrastructure including modern science and computer laboratories, spacious library, seminar halls, playgrounds, safe transport with GPS tracking, and biometric attendance system.
responses.does shivbhumi have transportation: Yes, Shivbhumi provides dedicated school bus service covering major areas of Pune with GPS tracking and trained staff for student safety.
responses.what extracurricular activities at shivb: Shivbhumi offers comprehensive co-curricular activities including sports, arts, cultural programs, NCC (National Cadet Corps), NSS, and various leadership development programs.
responses.what values does shivbhumi teach: Shivbhumi instills strong Indian values including integrity, empathy, resilience, and celebrates rich Indian heritage through innovative cultural programs.
responses.what is shivbhumi vision: Shivbhumi's vision is to nurture minds with academic excellence and strong Indian values, ensuring every student grows into a confident and responsible individual.
responses.what boards are affiliated with shivbhum: Shivbhumi schools are affiliated with Maharashtra State Board and CBSE (Central Board of Secondary Education).
responses.does shivbhumi have english medium: Yes, Shivbhumi English Medium School follows CBSE curriculum with bilingual instruction (English and Marathi) from pre-primary level.
responses.what is the motto of shivbhumi: The motto of Shivbhumi is 'न हि ज्ञानेन सदृशम् पवित्रमिह विद्यते' which translates to 'There is nothing as pure as knowledge in this world.'
responses.how old is shivbhumi: Shivbhumi Shikshan Mandal is 67 years old, having been established in 1957.
responses.what awards has shivbhumi received: The founder, Late Shri Shivajirao Narayanrao Konde-Deshmukh, received the prestigious Shikshan Maharshi Award from the Annasaheb Social Sports Foundation.
responses.does shivbhumi have sports facilities: Yes, Shivbhumi has extensive sports facilities including huge outdoor playgrounds, sports coaching, and participates in various inter-school competitions.
responses.what about shivbhumi ncc: Shivbhumi offers National Cadet Corps (NCC) program for leadership development and discipline building.
responses.is shivbhumi good for academics: Yes, Shivbhumi consistently achieves excellent board results and prepares students for competitive exams with experienced faculty and modern teaching methods.
